name: Tuyết - Southern Vietnamese Storyteller
description: A warm and expressive Southern Vietnamese female voice, ideal for storytelling, narration, audiobooks, educational content, and emotional reading. Natural, engaging, and easy to listen to, with a gentle Southern Vietnamese accent and expressive delivery.

description: A clear, natural Vietnamese voice with a warm, professional tone. Ideal for e-learning, corporate training, and explainer videos. Confident, instructional cadence that keeps listeners engaged.

name: Chi
description: Chi has a warm, youthful, and naturally expressive voice that feels like talking to a real person rather than listening to a scripted performance. Her voice works especially well for social media, short-form videos, product reviews, lifestyle content, storytelling, and casual commentary.

name: Nguyen TheManh

name: Yuna - Playful, Bright & Curious
description: A bright and expressive young girl voice with a playful, curious, and energetic personality. Perfect for animated characters, children's stories, fairy tales, visual novels, games, and lively conversations. Natural, cheerful, and full of youthful charm.

name: Cam Hong - HCM Local
description: Cẩm Hồng was born and raised in Ho Chi Minh City, and she carries that Southern warmth the way people from home always do — easy, unguarded, the kind of kindness that doesn't announce itself. She gives generously, without keeping score, and says what she means, always gently. Open-hearted, a little playful, never performative. Just genuine, no matter who's around.

name: Giang - Podcast

Exceptionally clear pacing makes it ideal for educational content, corporate narrations, and professional AI voice agents.
